newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Cofinec to merge Hungarian units.
newsitem.headline: Cofinec to merge Hungarian units.

text.p: French packaging firm Cofinec S.A. said on Thursday it is planning to merge its two Hungarian units, Kner Nyomdaipari Rt and Petofi Nyomdaipari es Csomagoloipari Rt, to improve performance in Hungary this year.

"To improve productivity, to reduce costs and to increase competitiveness they (the supervisory board and the management) will propose (to shareholders) the merger of Cofinec's two Hungarian units, Petofi Rt and Kner Rt without delay," Cofinec said in a statement.
Cofinec, whose GDRs are listed on the Budapest Stock Exchange, said it intended to implement the merger in the first half of 1997.
The merger will result in personnel changes, it said.
Petofi Rt's general director Laszlo Sebesvari, who resigned from his position effective January 15, is to become an advisor to the group's supervisory board.
"Mr Sebesvari will advise on the fields of strategy, organisation and marketing policy with the key multinational clients," the statement said. "He will advise regarding potential new projects, too."
While the merger of the two units is under preparation, Tibor Szabados, production director of Petofi Rt, will become Petofi's temporary general director, it said.
Following the merger one general director is expected to lead the merged Hungarian operations, the statement said, adding they expected Miklos Balog, chairman and CEO of Kner to receive this job.
Last September Cofinec set aside 22 million French francs to finance the costs of the merger.
This amount, with an additional two million francs to be spent on the organisation of the planned holding, is to be recorded on the 1996 accounts, it said.
